n4cb9e3b6e59.s: Dowry death (old IPC Section 304B) is covered under which section of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita?
n4cb9e3b6e59.x: Dowry death is BNS Section 80 (IPC 304B). Sections 85-86 cover cruelty (IPC 498A); the presumption is BSA Section 118.

nbb880ed53cf.s: Trafficking of persons is covered under which section of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita?
nbb880ed53cf.x: Trafficking is under BNS Section 143; Section 124 concerns acid attack.

n0cd9a5df8f2.s: Which tier of the US Trafficking in Persons Report is the only one fully meeting the minimum standards?
n0cd9a5df8f2.x: Only Tier 1 fully meets the US minimum standards; Tier 2 countries are making significant efforts without fully meeting them.

ncac29a321c8.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the definition of trafficking under the Criminal Law (Amendment) Act, 2013?
o: It applies only where the victim did not consent
ncac29a321c8.x: The CLA 2013 definition covers all forms of trafficking irrespective of the victim's consent, so the consent condition is false.

n5e9ac65aa4f.s: Which of the following contributes to under-reporting of violence against women?
o: A large share of women in the police
n5e9ac65aa4f.x: Stigma, fear, lack of awareness and economic dependence cause under-reporting; conviction rates are low and pendency high.

n8d853ac364b.s: Honour killings violate which of the following sets of Articles?
n8d853ac364b.x: Honour killings violate Articles 14, 15, 19 and 21, which protect equality, freedoms and life and personal liberty.

n7d1bd96b596.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Article 24 – Prohibits traffic in human beings
Palermo Protocol – Supplements the UN Convention against Transnational Organized Crime
BNS Section 143 – Victim's consent is necessary
2021 draft trafficking Bill – CBI as national investigating agency
n7d1bd96b596.x: The Palermo Protocol supplements UNTOC and addresses trafficking, especially of women and children; India has ratified it. Traffic in human beings is Article 23, consent is immaterial under s.143, and the 2021 draft named the NIA.

nac07a1389a3.s: One Stop Centres (Sakhi) for women are funded from the:
nac07a1389a3.x: One Stop Centres, Women Helpline 181 and ERSS 112 are all funded by the Nirbhaya Fund.

n819d2f21b62.s: Along with zero tolerance to atrocities against women, the Trishul committees of Andhra Pradesh pursue:
o: Zero dropouts and zero child labour
Zero drugs and zero road accidents
Zero dowry and zero child marriage
n819d2f21b62.x: Trishul committees are State and district panels pursuing zero drugs, zero tolerance to atrocities against women and zero road accidents.

nd02f278491c.s: The further 4.4% decline in crimes against women in Andhra Pradesh was credited to Shakti Teams, Women's Safety Week rallies and:
o: Replacing all police stations with women police stations
Death sentences under the Disha Act
nd02f278491c.x: The decline was credited to Shakti Teams, Women's Safety Week rallies and Sexual Offender Sheets; the Disha Act is not in force.

n8d92f278a97.s: As per Census 2011, the adult sex ratio of Andhra Pradesh was:
n8d92f278a97.x: Andhra Pradesh's adult sex ratio was 996 against India's 943; its child sex ratio was 944 against India's 918.

nd4d843c7221.s: Which section of the BNS deals with sexual intercourse by deceitful means, such as a false promise of marriage or job?
nd4d843c7221.x: BNS Section 69 is the new offence of intercourse by deceitful means, including false promise of marriage or job and identity fraud.

n8709d361ac6.s: Which of the following was a principal policy outcome of the December 2012 Nirbhaya case?
n8709d361ac6.x: The Nirbhaya outcomes were the Verma Committee, CLA 2013, the Nirbhaya Fund and the JJ Act 2015; the BNS was not one of them.

n633c9a4fb08.s: The Justice J.S. Verma Committee recommended keeping the age of consent at 16, but Parliament fixed it at:
n633c9a4fb08.x: The Committee recommended retaining 16 years (and opposed death for rape and sought criminalising marital rape); Parliament chose 18.

n202e9fe3381.s: What happened to the Trafficking of Persons Bill, 2018?
o: It was passed by the Lok Sabha but lapsed
It was passed by both Houses and became an Act
It was passed only by the Rajya Sabha
It was rejected by the Lok Sabha
n202e9fe3381.x: The 2018 Bill was passed by the Lok Sabha and later lapsed; the NIA proposal came in the 2021 draft Bill.

n13225f9d492.s: Under Mission Shakti, Shakti Sadan and PMMVY fall under which sub-scheme?
n13225f9d492.x: Samarthya is the empowerment component (Shakti Sadan, PMMVY); Sambal is the safety component (OSC, 181, Nari Adalat).

nc70e5d47f6d.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Nirbhaya Fund – created after the 2019 Hyderabad case
nc70e5d47f6d.x: ERSS uses the single emergency number 112. The women helpline is 181, the cyber helpline 1930, and the Nirbhaya Fund followed the 2012 Delhi case.

n7b877b7138e.s: Which system of the NCRB links police stations across the country?
n7b877b7138e.x: CCTNS links police stations nationwide; NDSO is the database of convicted sexual offenders.

nf78f927c050.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Sashakt Panchayat Netri Abhiyan?
o: It trains Women Elected Representatives in leadership
It has legal-awareness and gender-justice modules
It includes modules on gender-based violence
nf78f927c050.x: Sashakt Panchayat Netri Abhiyan trains women representatives; sensitising male representatives is Nirbhay Raho - Nirbhay Chetna.

nindian-polity-76-26.s: Women's reservation in the Legislative Assembly of the NCT of Delhi is provided under Article:
nindian-polity-76-26.x: Delhi is covered by Article 239AA(2)(ba), not 332A; it covers directly elected and SC seats since Delhi has no ST seats.

n38ed6474003.s: The Constitution (106th Amendment) Act, 2023 was introduced in Parliament as the:
n38ed6474003.x: The 2023 Bill was introduced as the 128th Amendment Bill and enacted as the 106th Amendment Act.

n08c0f4e16e1.s: The proposed 131st Constitutional Amendment Bill, 2026 sought to raise the Lok Sabha's strength from 550 to:
n08c0f4e16e1.x: The Bill sought to expand the Lok Sabha from 550 to 850 seats on the basis of the 2011 Census.

nindian-polity-76-7.s: Which Article ties the start of women's legislative reservation to delimitation after the first Census following the 106th Amendment?
nindian-polity-76-7.x: Article 334A makes the reservation start only after delimitation on the first Census after the Act, so it is not immediate.

nindian-polity-76-41.s: Within seats reserved for SCs and STs in Panchayats, the minimum share for SC/ST women is:
nindian-polity-76-41.x: Article 243D(2) reserves not less than one-third of SC/ST seats for SC/ST women, not 50%.

n245cb08ab43.s: The constitutional one-third reservation for women in Panchayats and Municipalities is:
o: A floor that States may raise
A ceiling that States cannot exceed
n245cb08ab43.x: One-third is a floor, not a ceiling; States may raise it, and several provide one-half.

nindian-polity-76-15.s: Bihar became the first State to provide 50% reservation for women in Panchayats in:
nindian-polity-76-15.x: The constitutional baseline is one-third; Bihar first raised it to 50% in 2006.

n35cd6fcaad0.s: In the 2023 Global Gender Gap Index, India's parity in economic participation was about:
n35cd6fcaad0.x: India's economic participation parity was only 36.7% in 2023, while enrolment parity was achieved at all levels.

n921521ebd01.s: Which of the following pairs about women's electoral participation is correctly matched?
n921521ebd01.x: Women first out-voted men in 2019 (and again in 2024). SVEEP is the ECI's programme, the 18th Lok Sabha has 74 women, and AP had 22 women in 2024 (14 in 2019).

new.s: The Immoral Traffic (Prevention) Act, originally the SITA, was enacted in:
new.x: It was enacted in 1956 as the Suppression of Immoral Traffic Act; 1986 is only the amendment that renamed it ITPA.

new.s: Which of the following pairs (law – year) is INCORRECTLY matched?
new.x: The Prohibition of Child Marriage Act is of 2006, not 2005; the other pairs are correct.

new.s: The Commission of Sati (Prevention) Act, 1987 came into force in:
new.x: The Sati Act was enacted in 1987 and came into force in 1988.

new.s: Under the Commission of Sati (Prevention) Act, property used for the glorification of sati may be seized by the:
new.x: The Act punishes attempt, abetment and glorification of sati, and the DM may seize property used for glorification.

new.s: Dowry Prohibition Officers under Section 8B of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961 are appointed by the:
new.x: Section 8B provides for Dowry Prohibition Officers appointed by the State Government.

new.s: Under Section 3 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961, giving or taking dowry is punishable with imprisonment of:
new.x: Section 3 prescribes a minimum of 5 years plus fine; 6 months to 2 years is the Section 4 penalty for demanding dowry.

new.s: Which of the following is excluded from the definition of 'dowry' under the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961?
o: Property given after marriage in connection with it
Valuable security agreed to be given before marriage
Property given indirectly at the marriage
new.x: Dowry covers property given before, at or after marriage, directly or indirectly, but dower or mahr is excluded.

new.s: Dowry death and its presumption were brought into the IPC and Evidence Act by the Dowry Prohibition amendment of:
new.x: The Act was amended in 1984 and 1986; the 1986 amendment brought dowry death (IPC 304B) and its presumption (Evidence Act 113B).

new.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about offences under the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961?
o: The burden of proof lies on the accused
new.x: Dowry offences are cognisable, non-bailable and non-compoundable, so 'compoundable' is wrong.

new.s: In Andhra Pradesh, Protection Officers under the Domestic Violence Act, 2005 are:
new.x: In AP, the DWCDA Project Directors and RDOs serve as Protection Officers, with 55 NGOs as Service Providers.

new.s: Under the POSH Act, 2013, an Internal Committee must be set up at every workplace with at least:
new.x: An Internal Committee is required at every workplace with 10 or more employees; smaller ones are served by the Local Committee.

new.s: The Local Committee under the POSH Act, 2013 is constituted at the district level by the:
new.x: The District Officer sets up the Local Committee for workplaces with fewer than 10 employees or complaints against the employer.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Internal Committee under the POSH Act, 2013?
o: It is presided over by a senior woman employee
At least half its members are women
It is constituted by the District Officer
new.x: The District Officer constitutes the Local Committee; the Internal Committee is set up at the workplace, headed by a senior woman employee.

new.s: Under the POSH Act, the employer must act on the inquiry report within:
new.x: The inquiry must finish in 90 days and the employer must act within 60 days; complaints are made within 3 months.

new.s: Under the Maternity Benefit (Amendment) Act, 2017, maternity leave for the first two children is:
new.x: The 2017 amendment raised leave for the first two children from 12 to 26 weeks.

new.s: Under the Maternity Benefit (Amendment) Act, 2017, a commissioning mother is entitled to maternity leave of:
new.x: Adoptive mothers of a child below 3 months and commissioning mothers get 12 weeks, not 26.

new.s: The Maternity Benefit (Amendment) Act, 2017 makes a creche mandatory in establishments with at least:
new.x: From 1 July 2017, establishments with 50 or more employees must provide a creche.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the Maternity Benefit (Amendment) Act, 2017:
1. Leave from the third child onwards is 12 weeks.
2. The employer must allow work from home after the leave in every case.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Statement 1 is correct. Statement 2 is wrong: the employer may allow work from home after the leave by mutual agreement.

new.s: Voyeurism (old IPC Section 354C) is dealt with under which section of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita?
new.x: Voyeurism is BNS Section 77; 75 is sexual harassment, 78 stalking and 74 outraging modesty.

new.s: Sexual harassment (old IPC Section 354A) corresponds to which section of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita?
new.x: Sexual harassment is BNS Section 75, corresponding to IPC 354A.

new.s: The Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 came into force on:
new.x: The BNS offences against women apply from 1 July 2024.

new.s: Acid-attack injury is listed as a disability under the:
o: Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016
new.x: The RPwD Act 2016 lists acid-attack injury as a disability.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT punishable under the Immoral Traffic (Prevention) Act, 1956?
o: Living on the earnings of prostitution
new.x: ITPA does not punish prostitution itself; it punishes brothel-keeping, soliciting, living on earnings and detaining persons.

new.s: Which Article of the Constitution prohibits traffic in human beings, begar and forced labour?
new.x: Article 23 prohibits traffic in human beings, begar and forced labour; Article 24 deals with child labour.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about constitutional safeguards against exploitation:
1. Article 23 prohibits traffic in human beings, begar and forced labour.
2. Article 24 bars children below 14 from factories, mines and hazardous work.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Both are correct: Article 23 covers trafficking, begar and forced labour; Article 24 bars child labour below 14 in hazardous work.

new.s: The Trafficking of Persons Bill, 2018 was passed by the Lok Sabha on:
new.x: The Bill was passed by the Lok Sabha on 26 July 2018 but lapsed; a 2021 draft followed.

new.s: One Stop Centres (Sakhi), funded by the Nirbhaya Fund, have functioned since:
new.x: One Stop Centres began on 1 April 2015 under the Nirbhaya Fund, giving shelter, police, legal and medical help under one roof.

new.s: As of 31 July 2025, how many Fast Track Special Courts were functional in India?
new.x: 743 FTSCs were functional, including 394 exclusive POCSO courts.

new.s: Anti-Human Trafficking Units (AHTUs) are district units working under the:
new.x: AHTUs are district police units under an SP/DSP.

new.s: Which of the following is a Special and Local Laws (SLL) crime head rather than an IPC/BNS head?
o: Offences under the Domestic Violence Act, 2005
new.x: PWDVA offences are an SLL head; cruelty, kidnapping and dowry death are IPC/BNS heads.

new.s: Women form only about what share of India's police force?
new.x: Only 11.7% of police are women, one sign of weak justice delivery along with low conviction and high pendency.

new.s: In Crime in India 2023, Andhra Pradesh's rank in crimes against women was:
new.x: AP recorded 22,418 cases in 2023 and ranked 11th in India.

new.s: According to NCRB data, which State leads in child marriage cases?
new.x: Assam leads, with 5,267 of 6,038 child marriage cases nationally in 2023.

new.s: Cyber crimes against women rose by about what percentage between 2017 and 2022?
new.x: They rose about 239% (stalking, morphing, trolling); 72.6% is the fraud share of cybercrime in 2024.

new.s: Crime in India 2024 is the first NCRB report to give data under the:
new.x: Crime in India 2024, released in May 2026, is the first report with BNS data beside IPC data.

new.s: The rape conviction rate in India in 2023 was:
new.x: The rape conviction rate was 22.7% in 2023, down from 27-28% in 2018-22.

new.s: In the 2023 break-up of crimes against women, the share of cruelty by husband or relatives was:
new.x: Cruelty had a 29.8% share in 2023; about 42% is its 2024 share. 19.8% is kidnapping and 18.7% assault.

new.s: Which State recorded the most trafficking cases in 2024?
new.x: Telangana recorded the most trafficking cases in 2024.

new.s: According to NFHS-5, India's overall sex ratio was:
new.x: NFHS-5 overall sex ratio is 1,020 (NFHS-4: 991); 929 is sex ratio at birth and 918 the 2011 child sex ratio.

new.s: According to NFHS-5, what share of women aged 18-49 faced physical violence?
new.x: 29% of women aged 18-49 faced physical violence; 32% of ever-married women faced spousal violence.

new.s: Besides Justice J.S. Verma, the Verma Committee consisted of:
new.x: The members were J.S. Verma, Leila Seth and Gopal Subramanium.

new.s: The Criminal Law (Amendment) Act, 2013 fixed the minimum punishment for rape at:
new.x: CLA 2013 fixed a minimum of 7 years; CLA 2018 raised it to 10 years.

new.s: Which of the following pairs (IPC section added in 2013 – offence) is INCORRECTLY matched?
new.x: 354C is voyeurism; sexual harassment is 354A.

new.s: Under the Criminal Law (Amendment) Act, 2018, rape of a girl below 12 years is punishable with:
new.x: For a girl under 12 the punishment is 20 years to life or death; for under 16 the minimum is 20 years.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the Criminal Law (Amendment) Act, 2018:
1. It raised the minimum punishment for rape from 7 to 10 years.
2. It bars anticipatory bail for rape of a girl below 16.
3. It allows 6 months for investigation of rape.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
new.x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. Statement 3 is wrong: investigation must end in 2 months; 6 months is for appeals.

new.s: In Laxmi v. Union of India (2013), acid may be sold over the counter only against:
o: Photo ID and the stated purpose
new.x: The SC allowed sale only against photo ID and a recorded purpose, with a register and no sale to under-18s.

new.s: Acid attack under IPC Section 326A now corresponds to which BNS provision?
new.x: 326A acid attack is BNS 124(1); 326B attempted acid attack is 124(2).

new.s: The Witness Protection Scheme, 2018 is enforced under which Article until a law is made?
new.x: The Witness Protection Scheme 2018 is enforced under Article 141 till a law is made.

new.s: UNODC's Global Report on Trafficking in Persons 2016 found that victims and traffickers often:
new.x: GLOTIP 2016 found that victims and traffickers often share the same background.

new.s: The 2021 draft trafficking Bill proposed which body as the national investigating agency?
new.x: The 2021 draft Bill named the NIA as the national investigating agency.

new.s: The Palermo Protocol on trafficking in persons was adopted in:
new.x: The Palermo Protocol (2000) supplements UNTOC and targets trafficking, especially of women and children.

new.s: The Central Victim Compensation Fund (MHA, 2015) supports State victim-compensation schemes through:
o: A one-time grant from the Nirbhaya Fund
new.x: The CVCF received a one-time grant from the Nirbhaya Fund to support State schemes.

new.s: Which system tracks the two-month deadline for investigation of sexual offences?
new.x: ITSSO (BPR&D) tracks investigations; NDSO is the offender database.

new.s: The National Database on Sexual Offenders (2018) is maintained by the:
new.x: NDSO is maintained by the NCRB and holds data on convicted sexual offenders for police use.

new.s: The Fast Track Special Courts (FTSC) scheme was launched in:
new.x: The FTSC scheme (2019) followed the Criminal Law (Amendment) Act, 2018.

new.s: Which State announced 45 fast-track courts in December 2019?
new.x: Odisha announced 45 fast-track courts in December 2019.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about fast-track courts:
1. They were created by the Criminal Law (Amendment) Act, 2013.
2. The FTSC scheme followed the Criminal Law (Amendment) Act, 2018.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Fast-track courts are administrative and were not created by CLA 2013, so 1 is wrong; the FTSC scheme followed CLA 2018.

new.s: In 2022, which district of Andhra Pradesh recorded the most rape cases?
new.x: Visakhapatnam had the most rape cases (69), followed by NTR district (51).

new.s: In 2021, the conviction rate for crimes against women in Andhra Pradesh was only:
new.x: AP's rate was 5.6%, among the lowest, against India's 26.5%; 86.7% was AP's pendency.

new.s: 'Abhay', offering free pick-up and drop for women from 9 pm to 5 am, was started in:
new.x: Abhay is the Prakasam (Ongole) ride scheme; Abhayam is the Chittoor awareness campaign.

new.s: Abhayam, launched in December 2019, was an awareness campaign of which district?
new.x: Abhayam was a Chittoor awareness campaign; Abhay is the Ongole pick-up scheme.

new.s: In Andhra Pradesh, Mahila Samrakshana Karyadarsi are women-protection functionaries in:
new.x: Mahila Samrakshana Karyadarsi work in village and ward secretariats.

new.s: Under the Factories Act 1948, the 'occupier' is the person who:
o: Owns the land of the factory
Has ultimate control over the affairs of the factory
new.x: The occupier is the person with ultimate control over the factory's affairs.

new.s: Inspectors under the Factories Act 1948 are appointed by the:
new.x: Inspectors are appointed by the State Government, and every District Magistrate is an Inspector for his district.

new.s: Under the Factories Act 1948, if no manager is named, who is deemed to be the manager?
new.x: If no manager is named, the occupier is deemed the manager.

new.s: The Factories Act 1948 was the first post-1947 law to fix the minimum age for factory work at:
new.x: The Factories Act fixed 14 years as the minimum age for factory work.

new.s: Which Articles of the Constitution enable women to contest elections to Parliament and State Legislatures?
new.x: Articles 84 and 173 let women contest; Articles 325 and 326 give equal franchise.

new.s: Reservation of at least one-third of Chairperson offices in Panchayats for women is provided under Article:
new.x: 243D(4) covers women chairpersons; 243D(3) covers women's seats and 243T(4) is the municipal provision.

new.s: The minimum age to contest elections to Panchayats and Municipalities is:
new.x: Under Articles 243F and 243V the minimum age is 21, not 25.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about reservation in Panchayats:
1. Women's reservation has no sunset clause.
2. SC/ST reservation is tied to Article 334 and runs to 2030.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Both are correct: women's local quota has no sunset, while SC/ST reservation follows Article 334 to 2030 (104th Amendment).

new.s: How many States/UTs now provide 50% reservation for women in local bodies?
new.x: 19 States/UTs now give 50%, above the constitutional floor of one-third.

new.s: Reservation of seats for STs in Municipalities is provided under Article:
new.x: ST seats in municipalities fall under 243T(1); 243T(3) and 243T(4) cover women's seats and chairs.

new.s: Reservation for Backward Classes in Panchayats under the 73rd Amendment is:
new.x: BC reservation in local bodies is optional and left to the States.

new.s: The 81st Constitution Amendment Bill on women's reservation (1996) was introduced by the government of:
new.x: The 81st Amendment Bill of 1996 came under the Deve Gowda government and lapsed.

new.s: The 108th Constitution Amendment Bill on women's reservation was passed by the Rajya Sabha on:
new.x: The 108th Bill passed the Rajya Sabha on 9 March 2010 and lapsed in 2014.

new.s: Under Article 334A, women's reservation in the Lok Sabha and Assemblies lasts for:
new.x: It lasts 15 years, extendable by Parliament, with seats rotating after each delimitation.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the Constitution (106th Amendment) Act, 2023:
1. One-third of SC/ST seats are reserved for women.
2. It provides an OBC sub-quota for women.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Statement 1 is correct; statement 2 is wrong because there is no OBC sub-quota.

new.s: The 131st Amendment Bill, 2026 won 298 votes against 230. How many votes were needed under Article 368?
new.x: With 528 present, 352 votes were needed; 298 fell short, so the Bill was defeated on 17 April 2026.

new.s: How many women were elected to the 18th Lok Sabha (2024)?
new.x: The 18th Lok Sabha has 74 women (13.6%); the 17th had 78, the highest.

new.s: Which Lok Sabha had the highest number of women members, 78?
new.x: The 17th Lok Sabha (2019) had 78 women (14.4%), the highest so far.

new.s: How many women were elected to the 175-member Andhra Pradesh Assembly in 2024?
new.x: 22 of 175 (13%) were women in 2024, up from 14 in 2019.

new.s: Which programme of the Election Commission of India targets women voters, among others?
new.x: The ECI's SVEEP programme targets women voters.

new.s: Who was the first woman President of the Indian National Congress (1917)?
new.x: Annie Besant was the first woman INC President (1917); Sarojini Naidu was the first Indian woman President (1925).

new.s: Who was the first Chairperson of the National Commission for Women?
new.x: Jayanti Patnaik was the first NCW Chairperson.

new.s: The National Commission for Women was set up in 1992 under the NCW Act of:
new.x: NCW was set up in 1992 under the NCW Act, 1990.

new.s: The Chattopadhyay-Duflo study (2004) on women pradhans was based on random reservation in:
new.x: It studied random pradhan reservation in West Bengal and Rajasthan; women leaders invested more in drinking water and roads.

new.s: In Therku Thittai panchayat (Cuddalore, Tamil Nadu, 2020), the Dalit woman president was:
o: Removed from office by the Collector
Made to sit on the floor at meetings
new.x: She was made to sit on the floor at meetings and barred from hoisting the flag; the secretary was arrested.

new.s: The practice of a male relative informally running an elected woman sarpanch's office is called:
new.x: Sarpanch-pati is proxy representation; it does not legally replace her and declines in a second term.

new.s: In the Global Gender Gap Index 2025, India's rank was:
new.x: India ranked 131st of 148 in 2025; 127th was 2023, 129th 2024 and 135th 2022.

new.s: Which country topped the Global Gender Gap Index 2025 for the 16th year?
new.x: Iceland was first in 2025, for the 16th year.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about gender indices?
o: The GDI is published by the UNDP
The GGGI is published by the World Economic Forum
In the GII, 1 denotes the worst position
Reproductive health is a dimension of the GGGI
new.x: Reproductive health is a dimension of the UNDP's GII, not of the WEF's GGGI.

new.s: In the Human Development Report 2025, India's rank in the Gender Inequality Index was:
new.x: India ranked 102nd (108th earlier), pulled down by low female labour force participation and representation.
